work.label: Work
work.title: Selected projects
work.subtitle: A curated selection of websites, landing pages, and interfaces I've designed and built.

items.title: SaaS Landing Page
items.summary: High-converting landing page focused on clear value proposition and frictionless conversion.
items.challenge: A strong product had low conversion rates due to a cluttered, unfocused landing page.
items.solution: Redesigned the entire page hierarchy to guide the visitor from problem to solution in 3 scrolls — clear CTA above the fold, social proof, and a clean pricing table.
items.result: Significant improvement in conversion rate and average session duration.

items.title: Corporate Website Redesign
items.summary: Full redesign modernizing the visual identity and improving user experience from the ground up.
items.challenge: Outdated design, high bounce rate, and no mobile optimization.
items.solution: Complete visual redesign with a modern design system, mobile-first development, and content restructuring to drive contact inquiries.
items.result: Reduced bounce rate and increased time on page.

items.title: Event Landing Page
items.summary: Visually-driven page designed to communicate energy and convert visitors into registrations.
items.challenge: The client needed to convey excitement and urgency while simplifying the registration process.
items.solution: Bold hero with countdown timer, speaker highlights, and a one-step registration form embedded directly on the page.
items.result: Registration target achieved ahead of schedule.

items.title: E-commerce Product Page
items.summary: High-converting product page combining clean UI with persuasive design principles.
items.challenge: Low add-to-cart rate despite good product quality and competitive pricing.
items.solution: Redesigned with a clear visual hierarchy, trust signals, and a streamlined purchase flow.
items.result: Increased add-to-cart conversion and lower cart abandonment.

items.title: Creative Portfolio
items.summary: Premium portfolio for a creative professional designed to attract international clients.
items.challenge: A talented professional with no strong online presence, missing international opportunities.
items.solution: Bespoke single-page portfolio with custom animations, multilingual support, and a direct-action contact strategy.
items.result: Client received first international inquiry within weeks of launch.

items.title: Corporate Design System
items.summary: Component library eliminating visual inconsistencies across 400+ projects and accelerating delivery.
items.challenge: Visual inconsistencies across all deliverables, requiring manual recreation of each UI from scratch.
items.solution: Built a reusable component library in Figma and code, with documentation. Reduced per-project setup time dramatically.
items.result: Faster delivery, consistent visual quality, and a scalable foundation for future projects.

process.label: Process
process.title: How I work
process.subtitle: From the first conversation to a live website — every step handled with intention.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: I listen before I design. Understanding your goals, audience, and business is how I make sure the website works — not just looks good.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: I design in Figma, creating wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes. You see exactly what the website will look like before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: I build with clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Pixel-perfect, responsive on every screen size, and optimized for performance.

steps.title: Review
steps.description: We review together and refine until it's right. My attention to detail means feedback rounds are fast and clear.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: I handle the final checks, cross-browser testing, and go-live. You get a website that's ready — and a partner you can count on after delivery.

about.label: About
about.title: The person behind the work
paragraphs: I design and build modern websites that combine clean code, intuitive experiences, and visually polished interfaces. What drives me is that moment when a client sees their website for the first time and says — this is exactly what I imagined.

My background is rare: I think like a designer and build like a developer. That means no lost-in-translation between the Figma file and the browser. What you see in the prototype is what you get in production — down to the last pixel.
Over 4 years, I've designed and built 400+ websites — from landing pages for startups to full websites for established brands. Every single one built with the same care: from briefing to launch.
